name: OPIM 5516
title: Advanced Deep Learning
description: This course covers advanced AI models, including Bayesian Neural Networks, Graph Neural Networks, and Transformers. Students will gain hands-on experience implementing and evaluating these models using PyTorch, Keras and other software, with a focus on uncertainty quantification and explainable AI. Practical applications include tabular, time-series, and image data.
requirement_description: OPIM 5604 and OPIM 5509; open only to MBA, MSBAPM, and MS FinTech students, others with consent.
